summary: Build practical stock-control, replenishment, and warehouse KPI skills in a five-day course. Explore the outline and course details.
lede: Warehouse management training helps warehouse supervisors, inventory controllers, and stores officers control stock movements and maintain accurate records. Participants practise receiving and issue documentation, ABC classification and reorder calculations, FIFO/FEFO rotation, cycle counting, and Excel-based KPI reporting to investigate discrepancies and support routine replenishment decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who handle stock, coordinate warehouse activities, or review inventory performance. It suits people who need practical warehouse management methods for routine operations and reporting.
audience: Procurement officers using stock availability and reorder
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with routine stock receipt, storage, issue, or replenishment activities. No programming is required. Excel experience will help with the spreadsheet exercises.
